title: Push-ups
summary: A push-up works the chest, shoulders, triceps and core. Keep the body in a straight line from head to heels, hands slightly wider than shoulders, and lower until the chest is near the floor.
key_points: Beginners can start with knee or wall push-ups.
steps: Lower your chest with elbows about 45° from the body
Push back up without sagging hips
